title: CmdPal: Low-level keyboard hook toggle description is inversed
summary: The General settings description for the low-level keyboard hook states the opposite of the observed behavior: enabling it is needed to reach CmdPal from elevated apps.

status.detail: Correct the localized description and add a settings UI assertion.

proposed_fixes.title: Correct the low-level keyboard hook setting description
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The English localized description is phrased as though enabling the low-level hook causes the elevated-app limitation, although the setting exists to overcome that limitation.
plan: Rewrite Settings_GeneralPage_LowLevelHook_SettingsCard.Description in src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI/Strings/en-us/Resources.resw so it states that enabling the hook allows the shortcut to focus Command Palette from an elevated app.
Keep the existing setting key, checkbox binding, default, and runtime semantics unchanged in src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI/Settings/GeneralPage.xaml.
Add or update the existing CmdPal UI test to assert the setting is discoverable and its description matches the enabled behavior.
verification: Build CmdPal UI and the focused existing UI test target.
From an elevated application, toggle the setting and verify the documented shortcut behavior.
Confirm normal-application behavior and the setting default remain unchanged.

confidence.rationale: The inverted English resource text, its GeneralPage binding, and the reporter's screenshots directly support a copy-only correction; only runtime confirmation and other-locale review remain.

judgment.rationale: The current resource text says to use the hook if the shortcut cannot focus CmdPal from an elevated app, while the report says enabling the setting prevents that behavior.
evidence: Observed: Resources.resw key Settings_GeneralPage_LowLevelHook_SettingsCard.Description currently says to use the setting if the shortcut cannot focus CmdPal from an elevated app.
Observed: GeneralPage.xaml binds that resource to the UseLowLevelGlobalHotkey checkbox.
Observed: the reporter supplies current and previous screenshots and explains the integrity-level behavior.
Inferred: this is a documentation/copy inversion, not evidence that the hook implementation itself is broken.
judgment.recommended_action: Approve a resource-only wording correction plus a UI test that asserts the intended description.
